title: Thought-deciphering via hierarchical EEG-to-text alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.03623v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Non-invasive brain-to-text interfaces offer alternative communication pathways for people with communication disabilities. However, sentence-level decoding from electroencephalography (EEG) remains challenging. We propose a hierarchical EEG-text alignment framework that retrieves sentences by progressively decoding coarse-grained semantic information and fine-grained sentence representations. We hypothesize that broader semantic context can be more reliably captured from EEG than individual sentences. Accordingly, EEG representations are first aligned with semantic classes, followed by sentence retrieval within the predicted class. Among over 2,000 unique text samples, our approach achieves average top-5 and top-10 retrieval accuracies of 62.6\% $\pm$ 1.0\% and 83.5\% $\pm$ 1.0\%, respectively, compared with 50.3\% $\pm$ 2.3\% and 68.3\% $\pm$ 2.0\% for direct EEG-sentence alignment. translated_title: 通过分层脑电图-文本对齐实现思维破译
translated_abstract: 非侵入式脑到文本接口为有沟通障碍的人群提供了替代性沟通途径。然而，从脑电图（EEG）进行句子级别的解码仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种分层脑电图-文本对齐框架，通过逐步解码粗粒度语义信息和细粒度句子表示来检索句子。我们假设，相比单个句子，更广泛的语义背景能够从脑电图中被更可靠地捕获。因此，脑电图表示首先与语义类别进行对齐，随后在预测出的类别内进行句子检索。在超过2,000个独特文本样本中，我们的方法实现了平均top-5和top-10检索准确率分别为62.6% ± 1.0%和83.5% ± 1.0%，而直接进行脑电图-句子对齐的准确率仅为50.3% ± 2.3%和68.3% ± 2.0%。定性分析进一步揭示了……（摘要内容截断）
tldr: 提出一种分层脑电图-文本对齐框架，先解码粗粒度语义类别、再在类别内检索细粒度句子，显著提升了从EEG进行句子级解码的检索准确率。
